explanation: One of Jacob's sons, sold as a slave by his brothers and later became governor in Egypt.
The sons of Jacob who betrayed Joseph and sold him into slavery.
The land where Joseph became governor and where his family sought help during the famine.
A lack of food that strikes Egypt and Canaan, leading Joseph's brothers to travel to Egypt to buy grain.
When Joseph is reunited with his brothers and forgives them for their actions against him.
The patriarch and father of Joseph and his brothers, also known as Israel.
A region in Egypt where Joseph invites his family to live and survive the famine.
The act of accepting others' mistakes and letting go of the past, as Joseph does with his brothers.
